objects.name: Detection technique coverage: print-spooler-failed-to-load-a-plug-in
objects.description: The following analytic detects driver load errors in the Windows PrintService Admin logs, specifically identifying issues related to CVE-2021-34527 (PrintNightmare). It triggers on error messages indicating the print spooler failed to load a plug-in module, such as "meterpreter.dll," with error code 0x45A.
